generatedProse.practice-connection:
Creativity is named explicitly among the graduate attributes that disciplines and employers look for, alongside adaptability and flexibility. It is also the engine of original scholarship, where a new reading or synthesis moves a field forward. The students who treat creativity as something they exercise on purpose, rather than a gift they either have or lack, are the ones whose work keeps developing. Treat this course as being about the creativity your own degree and future work will reward, not creativity in the abstract.

The same demand runs through professional practice. Wherever problems arrive without a settled method, the people who make progress are those who generate workable options and adapt them as conditions change. The creativity you build here is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
